criteria.ideal: First visit explains deal trust signals and lets a user set merchant/category/keyword interests without forcing an account.
criteria.comparatorEvidence: HotUKDeals For You and Slickdeals personalized frontpage are officially documented; Dealabs has keyword/merchant/category alerts.
criteria.targetEvidence: Keyword notices and saved searches are verified; explicit first-run preference path is not confirmed.
criteria.improvement: Add an optional first-run interest chooser with a skip path.
criteria.verify: New browser test: choose interests, skip, reload, and confirm state survives.

criteria.ideal: A shopper can search, filter by merchant/price/date, sort, see no-result recovery, and retain sharable result state.
criteria.why: It is the shortest route to a relevant deal.
criteria.comparatorEvidence: Dealabs alert filtering and Slickdeals search are official; HotUKDeals documents deal categories/tabs.
criteria.targetEvidence: Search/filter/sort and URL-state pass in automated tests.
criteria.improvement: Add query suggestions, typo/synonym assistance, and recent searches with a local-only privacy note.
criteria.verify: Automated tests for suggestion selection, no-result alternatives, and cleared local history.

criteria.ideal: Every deal makes current price, observed history, source, update time, and limits of the history understandable.
criteria.why: Users must judge whether a deal is genuinely good.
criteria.comparatorEvidence: Honey officially presents price history and price-drop tracking; community platforms expose temperature/comments.
criteria.targetEvidence: 30-day price history is unit-tested; price provenance/update-time semantics are not confirmed.
criteria.improvement: Display data source, last checked time, history coverage, and a clear synthetic/demo-data label where applicable.
criteria.verify: Browser assertions for each label and a usability review with five target shoppers.

criteria.ideal: Votes, comments, expiration/sold-out state, and reports give a visible, reversible community trust signal.
criteria.why: Community evidence prevents stale or misleading savings claims.
criteria.comparatorEvidence: HotUKDeals documents temperature voting and comments; Slickdeals documents voting and expired-deal reporting.
criteria.targetEvidence: Voting/comment/report/sold-out features documented and tested; moderation response process unknown.
criteria.improvement: Show a compact trust explanation and a report status/outcome path.
criteria.verify: E2E for vote/report feedback plus moderator-policy review.

criteria.ideal: Users can create, preview, edit, pause, delete, and understand the delivery channel/limits of keyword and price alerts.
criteria.why: Alerts become harmful when their matching rules or opt-out path are unclear.
criteria.comparatorEvidence: Dealabs and HotUKDeals officially document keyword/price filters and email/browser/mobile notification preferences; Honey documents target-price tracking.
criteria.targetEvidence: Local keyword notices and bulk actions verified; actual remote push/email delivery is not verified.
criteria.improvement: Expose match preview, channel state, explicit local-only limitation, and one-tap pause/delete.
criteria.verify: E2E for edit/pause/delete and device test only after notification permission design is ready.

criteria.ideal: Saved searches, bookmarks, and notices can be exported, imported after comparison, restored, and deliberately erased.
criteria.why: A local-first service earns trust through user-controlled recovery and deletion.
criteria.comparatorEvidence: Honey and Dealabs both provide account/notification control patterns; target feature is a local-first differentiation.
criteria.targetEvidence: Export/import/snapshot/cleanup tests pass; a single plain-language data map is not confirmed.
criteria.improvement: Add a visible data inventory and a verified one-screen local-data erase path.
criteria.verify: E2E confirms inventory accuracy, erase confirmation, and no remaining local key.

criteria.ideal: Previously visited pages and essential local actions remain understandable offline, with a clear reconnect state.
criteria.why: Deal browsing often happens on variable mobile networks.
criteria.comparatorEvidence: This is a task-quality standard rather than a copied competitor screen; it meets the risk-reduction criterion.
criteria.targetEvidence: Offline reload/detail/backup and service-worker control pass.
criteria.improvement: Add an offline indicator, queued-action explanation, and cache freshness time.
criteria.verify: Playwright offline tests plus one selected idle Android device when a user-facing release candidate is ready.

criteria.ideal: Mobile and PC complete the same essential tasks with 44px touch targets, keyboard navigation, semantic controls, readable contrast, and human assistive-technology checks.
criteria.why: Deal hunting must work under touch, keyboard, and assistive technology.
criteria.comparatorEvidence: Risk-reduction standard; public platforms demonstrate cross-platform task continuity but do not prove accessibility conformance.
criteria.targetEvidence: 390px runtime audit passes 44px targets, skip link, named controls, contrast; TalkBack/Narrator human navigation not run.
criteria.improvement: Run structured TalkBack and Narrator scripts and fix findings.
criteria.verify: Recorded human task checklist on one idle Android device and one Windows screen-reader session.

criteria.ideal: Real-user performance thresholds, alerting, and historical trend review complement lab measurements.
criteria.why: A one-time fast lab run does not detect production slowdown.
criteria.targetEvidence: Runtime audit: FCP/LCP 156ms, CLS 0, 239ms first screen; no real-user telemetry or alert owner confirmed.
criteria.improvement: Define privacy-preserving performance SLOs and opt-in aggregate measurement before adding any analytics.
criteria.verify: Review dashboard data freshness and alert drill; do not collect personal data without a policy decision.

criteria.ideal: Every public version has repeatable cross-browser, link, console-error, and rollback evidence.
criteria.why: Community and links fail visibly when a static release drifts.
criteria.targetEvidence: Chrome/Edge matrix 60/60 and public HTTP 6/6; formal public rollback owner/process partially documented.
criteria.improvement: Add a read-only release evidence index and routine link checks.
criteria.verify: Independent public audit on each release and a documented rollback tabletop exercise.

criteria.ideal: Accurate terms, privacy notice, local-storage explanation, retention/deletion path, operator identity, and contact route are public before collecting more data or monetizing.
criteria.why: Users cannot make an informed choice otherwise.
criteria.comparatorEvidence: Honey publicly explains pricing/shopping data collection and notification controls; Dealabs help center exposes account deletion/support paths.
criteria.targetEvidence: Local-device data boundary exists; operator/contact and legal review are explicitly missing.
criteria.improvement: Have the operator provide truthful identity/contact and review localized notices; do not claim legal compliance without counsel.

criteria.ideal: If revenue begins, price, affiliate disclosure, ads, cancellation/refund, payment failures, and support are transparent before transaction.
criteria.why: Savings products lose trust when incentives are hidden.
criteria.comparatorEvidence: Honey describes coupon/rewards context; Dealabs has merchant-information/support sections.
criteria.targetEvidence: Paid checkout is blocked and no active paid model exists.
criteria.improvement: Keep payment blocked until the operator chooses a revenue model and required policies/processes exist.
criteria.verify: End-to-end sandbox then real controlled transaction/cancel/refund tests after explicit authorization.

criteria.ideal: A public support route, issue categories, response targets, incident owner, update notes, and moderation handoff exist.
criteria.why: Reports and deal disputes need accountable outcomes.
criteria.comparatorEvidence: Dealabs help center has support/contact and community moderation information; Slickdeals has support and reporting documentation.
criteria.targetEvidence: Product-side report feature exists; operator support channel and response targets missing.
criteria.improvement: Publish support contact, report categories, and a minimal incident/moderation playbook after operator decision.
criteria.verify: Submit a non-production support-route test and tabletop moderation case.

criteria.ideal: Community rules, report triage, copyright/right-infringement path, appeal, and audit trail match the user-generated-content scope.
criteria.why: Deal content has safety, deception, and intellectual-property risk.
criteria.comparatorEvidence: Dealabs and Slickdeals publicly document community/reporting pathways; HotUKDeals relies on community validation.
criteria.targetEvidence: Report controls verified; public rules, triage SLA, appeal, and legal path not confirmed.
criteria.improvement: Define a transparent community guideline and non-automated report handling process.
criteria.verify: Policy review and case-based moderator acceptance tests.

criteria.ideal: The team defines target users, activation/retention measures, and a privacy-respecting feedback loop before optimizing growth.
criteria.why: Feature activity alone is not evidence of user value or sustainable reach.
criteria.comparatorEvidence: Leading platforms use personalization and alert behavior; their business outcomes are not inferred here.
criteria.targetEvidence: 1,000-persona simulation exists; no real-user or operator KPI baseline confirmed.
criteria.improvement: Choose a minimal non-identifying product metric plan and obtain policy/consent decisions first.
criteria.verify: Metric definition review, consent review, then aggregate trend inspection.

criteria.ideal: Versioning, recovery, release checklist, Android channel decision, and ownership are explicit.
criteria.why: Static PWA changes still need a safe recovery path.
criteria.targetEvidence: Versioning, handoff package, migration simulation 1000/1000, service-worker update flow pass; signed Android distribution not decided.
criteria.improvement: Assign a release owner and decide whether Android remains PWA/launcher or enters a signed store channel.
criteria.verify: Release checklist review and recovery drill.

limits: These standards are product-analysis criteria, not legal advice, certification, competitor scorecards, or claims about external market performance.
